ढक्क: ढक्क ḍhakka, m. kind of edifice;  N. of a locality;  ā, f. large drum.
ढक्कदेशीय: ढक्कदेशीय ḍhakka-deśīya, a. peculiar to the country of Dhakka.
ढेङ्क: ढेङ्क ḍheṅka, m. kind of bird;  ī, f. kind of dance.
ढौक्: ढौक् ḌHAUK, I.Ā. ḍhauka, approach (ac.): ito ḍhaukasva, come here;  cs. ḍhauk--aya, P. bring near to (g.);  procure;  offer to (d.). upa, cs. offer;  prepare.
